newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 4-wk T-bill auction for Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 4-wk T-bill auction for Thurs.

text.p: The Czech central bank (CNB) on Wednesday set an auction for a 20 billion crown tranche of Finance Ministry four-week T-bills for Thursday, with gross maximum yield set at 25 percent, a CNB statement said.
The CNB statement added that five billion crowns worth of the paper would be made available at the auction.
Gross yield at the last auction of similar T-bills on April 15 was 11.79 percent.
The CNB statement added that net yield in the auction should be 18.75 percent.
